stem: A team wants to check a test's results every day and be allowed to stop early without inflating false positives. Which approach meets this need?

options.text: A fixed-horizon test, checked every day against p < 0.05
A sequential method with always-valid p-values, planned ahead
A Bonferroni correction across the success and guardrail metrics
A larger minimum detectable effect, so that the test ends sooner
